events.name: San Diego Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs beat San Diego 19-7 on Sunday to eliminate the Chargers from playoff contention, moments before they were eliminated themselves by games happening elsewhere.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs hold on to spoil Chargers' playoff hopes

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens earned a wild-card berth in the AFC playoffs Sunday, rallying to defeat the Cleveland Browns 20-10 while getting the help they needed halfway across the country.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens rally past Browns, earn playoff spot

headlines.description: Watt helps Texans to 23-17 win over Jaguars
headlines.shortLinkText: Watt helps Texans to 23-17 win over Jaguars

headlines.description: Roman Harper and Tre Boston returned interceptions for touchdowns as Carolina's defense led the Panthers to a 34-3 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday to win the NFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers win South with drubbing of Falcons

headlines.description: C.J. Anderson ran for three touchdowns, and the Broncos earned a first-round bye and the AFC's No. 2 seed with a 47-14 rout of the Raiders on Sunday.

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Limping Aaron Rodgers threw two touchdown passes to Randall Cobb, Eddie Lacy gashed Detroit's defense for 100 yards and the Green Bay Packers claimed a fourth straight NFC North title with 30-20 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers returns, leads Packers to North title

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw a go-ahead 3-yard touchdown pass to Bruce Miller late in the third quarter, and Jim Harbaugh won in his  last game leading the San Francisco 49ers, who beat the playoff-bound Arizona Cardinals 20-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers win in Jim Harbaugh's last game

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch scored on a 9-yard run with 12:07 remaining, Bruce Irvin returned an interception 49 yards for a touchdown and the Seahawks wrapped up home-field advantage through the NFC playoffs with a 20-6 win over the Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks rout Rams, seal NFC's No. 1 seed

headlines.description: Antonio Brown returned a punt 71 yards for a touchdown and added a clinching 63-yard scoring grab with 2:50 to go in the Steelers' 27-17 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday night that gave them the AFC North title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers best Bengals to win AFC North title
